t: This is 34 to 42 South Audley Street, a building in Westminster. It was designed by Thomas Verity, an English architect who lived from 1837 to 1891. Verity is known as a theatre architect, working during the theatre-building boom between 1885 and 1915. The material I have doesn't say more about this particular building, so it's enough to know that a specialist in theatres is the name behind its design.
